bio: Dorset Square Hotel is set in a beautiful Regency townhouse in the heart of Marylebone, which looks onto the leafy private garden square that was originally the site of Thomas Lord's first cricket ground. The hotel enjoys a cricket theme that transcends into the stylist restaurant, The Potting Shed.  You’ll enjoy their new garden-inspired classic Afternoon Tea, served every day between 1pm and 4pm. Enjoy sweet treats such as homemade Carrot cake and seasonal Strawberry and custard tart alongside a selection of finger sandwiches, Asparagus and cheddar quiche and Coronation chicken vol au vent. Each stand also comes with freshly baked Scones with clotted cream and jam, and of course tea, coffee or hot chocolate.  Please note that each guest dining must order Afternoon Tea - One Afternoon Tea cannot be shared between two or more guests
